brand.name: Brand
brand.paragraph: Every default in this theme comes from its reference design. Change any value here without touching code.

store_display_name.label: Store display name
store_display_name.info: Used where the storefront says your store's name in prose — the gift card page, the footer copyright. Leave empty to use your Shopify store name. The big wordmark's text is set on the Header, Hero, and Footer sections.

logo.label: Logo
logo.info: Replaces the text wordmark in the header, the overlay heads, and the footer. The hero keeps its lettered wordmark — its entrance and the nav's morph are drawn from the letters.

logo_inverted.label: Logo for dark backgrounds
logo_inverted.info: Used on the menu and search overlays and the footer when set; otherwise the main logo appears there too.

shop.name: Shop details
shop.paragraph: Stated once and used everywhere the shop states them: the menu overlay, the footer, and the Visit section.

shop_address_link.label: Map link
shop_address_link.info: Opens in a new tab wherever the address is shown.

shop_phone.label: Telephone
shop_phone.info: Shown as written; the tel: link strips spaces and punctuation.

page_width_narrow.label: Narrow page width
page_width_narrow.info: Used by the craft and visit layouts.

grid_min_column.label: Minimum product column width
grid_min_column.info: Product grids reflow when columns would get narrower than this.

gutter.label: Page gutter
gutter.info: Space between page content and the screen edge.

typography.name: Typography
typography.paragraph: Choose four font styles first, then define the ten presets used by text blocks throughout the theme.

font_accent.label: Accent
font_accent.info: Used by presets that need a distinctive editorial voice.

font_body.label: Body
font_body.info: Used for readable paragraphs and interface copy.

font_subheading.label: Subheading
font_subheading.info: Used for labels, eyebrows, and supporting headings.

font_heading.label: Heading
font_heading.info: Used for titles and the heading hierarchy.

typography.presets_paragraph: Each preset combines a font style, fluid size, line height, letter spacing, and case. Text blocks inherit these values unless an override is selected.

icons.name: Icons
icons.paragraph: Choose the responsive default size used by Icon blocks throughout the theme. Individual Icon blocks can inherit it or select another preset.

size.label: Icon size
size.info: Every preset scales smoothly between compact and wide screens.

section_padding_default.label: Default section padding
section_padding_default.info: Used by any section that does not set its own. Steps are the reference design’s own vertical rhythm.

space_base.label: Base spacing
space_base.info: Sets the whole spacing scale — every gap is a multiple of it.

colors.name: Colors
colors.paragraph: Each color scheme controls its own surfaces, button styles, hover states, overlays, feedback, and scrollbars.

accent.label: Accent
accent.info: The accent color used for micro labels, rules and emblems.

interface.loader_info: Inline waits such as search and catalog updates.
interface.loader_on_veil_info: Full-screen waits shown over the overlay veil.
interface.veil_info: The translucent wash behind drawers, Quick View, and splash screens.

page_scheme.label: Page color scheme
page_scheme.info: The scheme the page itself uses, behind every section.

dark_scheme.label: Dark surface scheme
dark_scheme.info: Used by the surfaces that stay dark whatever the page is — the menu and search overlays, the lookbook stage, image scrims.

close_delay.label: Show close after
close_delay.info: Used when a full-screen loading state is still waiting. The overlay background and Escape remain available immediately.

shape.name: Shape
shape.paragraph: The design pairs square cards and imagery with fully rounded buttons.

radius_arch.label: Arch height
radius_arch.info: The arched image top used by About and Visit.

hairline_opacity.label: Hairline strength
hairline_opacity.info: How visible the fine rules are against the background.

button_radius.label: Button shape
button_radius.info: Applies to every button type unless a Button block overrides it.

close_style.label: Close controls
close_style.info: Every overlay's close — the cart drawer, menus, search, quick view, and popups — as the word Close or as an × in a disc. One choice for all of them.

button_size.label: Button size
button_size.info: Sets label size and, for framed styles, padding across every button type unless a Button block overrides it.

badges.name: Product badges
badges.ignore_collection_info: Products in this collection never show badges on cards, product pages, featured products, recommendations, quick view, or cart upsells.
badges.show_custom_info: Add product tags such as badge: Limited edition. Text after badge: becomes the badge label.

sale_mode.label: Sale badge display
sale_mode.info: The saving follows the selected variant's current and compare-at prices.

quick_view_scroll.label: Two-column scrolling
quick_view_scroll.info: What moves when a piece has more to say than the panel can hold. Only applies where there is room for two columns; below that the whole panel scrolls whichever is chosen.
quick_view_scroll.media: Pin the media, scroll the panel

tax.name: Tax
tax.paragraph: Shopify automatically identifies tax-inclusive prices. Set the note used when taxes are not included.

tax_note_text.label: Tax-exclusive note
tax_note_text.info: Shown when Shopify reports that taxes are not included. Leave empty to say nothing.

price_compare_position.label: Compare-at price position
price_compare_position.info: Where the crossed-out original price sits relative to the current price, everywhere both are shown.

cart.name: Cart
cart.paragraph: The cart drawer and cart page are alternatives, not both. Every setting below applies to both.

cart_name.label: Cart name
cart_name.info: The customer-facing name shown throughout the storefront. For example: Cart, Bag, or Basket.

show_tax_note.label: Show the tax-exclusive note
show_tax_note.info: Shows the custom note when Shopify reports that taxes are not included. Tax-inclusive prices are always identified.

cart_note.label: Allow note to seller
cart_note.info: A message field submitted with the order.

cart_discounts.label: Show discounts in cart
cart_discounts.info: Lists any automatic discount or applied code above the subtotal.

cart_installments.label: Installments
cart_installments.info: Shopify shows this only where the shop is eligible and has it enabled.

cart_accelerated_checkout.label: Accelerated checkout buttons
cart_accelerated_checkout.info: Lets buyers check out faster and can improve conversion. Shown only where the shop has enabled a wallet.

cart_empty_link.label: Empty cart button link
cart_empty_link.info: Where the button in an empty cart goes. Defaults to all products.

cart_type.label: Opening the cart
cart_type.info: Without JavaScript the cart always falls back to the cart page.

cart_drawer_on_add.label: Open the drawer after adding
cart_drawer_on_add.info: Only applies while the drawer is chosen above.

cart_unit_price.label: Show the price of one
cart_unit_price.info: A line reads the price of a single piece rather than price × quantity. Applies to the cart drawer and the cart page.

cart_image_ratio.label: Image shape
cart_image_ratio.info: The frame a line’s photograph sits in, as on a product card.

cart_image_fit.label: Image fit
cart_image_fit.info: How the piece sits in that frame. Filled by default, where a card fits the whole piece — a 64px thumbnail has little room to give away.

search.name: Search
search.paragraph: Choose how Search opens throughout the storefront. Predictive results and the search page remain available in every mode.

search_type.label: Opening Search
search_type.info: Without JavaScript, Search always falls back to the search page.

filter_word.label: Filter word
filter_word.info: The word the storefront's filter button and drawer heading use — Filter, Refine, or your own. Sentences like “Clear filters” stay translatable in the language editor.

hidden_collections.label: Hidden collections
hidden_collections.info: Excluded from the collections page, search suggestions, and quick links. For collections that group products for a display or feature rather than for browsing. Sections where you pick collections yourself still show them.

localization.name: Localization
localization.paragraph: Selectors appear only when more than one country or language is published in your markets.

show_country_header.label: Show country selector in the header

show_country_footer.label: Show country selector in the footer

show_language_header.label: Show language selector in the header

show_language_footer.label: Show language selector in the footer

motion.name: Motion
motion.paragraph: Motion is disabled automatically for visitors who ask their device to reduce it.

video_pause_offscreen.label: Pause autoplaying video off screen
video_pause_offscreen.info: An ambient video pauses when less than a third of it is visible and resumes when it returns.

motion_duration.label: Motion speed
motion_duration.info: How long hovers and state changes take. Steps are the reference design’s own transition durations.

wrap.label: Word breaks
wrap.info: How the text divides across lines. Pretty keeps a last word from standing alone; Balanced evens the lines out.

gap.label: Vertical gap
gap.info: The space between every direct child of the section. Each step is a rung of the theme's own spacing scale.

text_preset.label: Text preset
text_preset.info: Uses a preset from Theme settings → Typography.

text_element.label: Element
text_element.info: What this is in the page's outline, which is a question for search engines rather than for how it looks. Use a heading level only for something that really is a heading.

text_color.label: Font color
text_color.info: Leave empty to inherit the current color scheme.

layout.label: Layout
layout.info: Choose the spacing treatment. Typography still comes from the selected text preset.

custom_liquid.label: Custom Liquid
custom_liquid.info: Add custom Liquid or HTML. This block follows the layout and spacing of the section or Group that contains it.

label.label: Look name
label.info: Used as the tab label when this section contains more than one interactive media block.

pulse.label: Pulse until a hotspot is chosen

hotspot.name: Hotspot
hotspot.timing_info: Only applies to video. Leave empty to keep the hotspot visible for the whole film.

hover_reveal.label: Show hover reveal
hover_reveal.info: Shows the collection action over the photograph when the card is hovered or focused.

fixed_size.label: Keep cards a consistent size
fixed_size.info: On, a short row keeps the same card width and image height as a full row instead of stretching to fill the section.

show_carousel.label: Show all images in a carousel
show_carousel.info: Off, the card is a single photograph and costs one image to load. On, it carries every image the product has — the hover preview, the arrows, a swipe on touch, and the video if there is one.

arrows_wide.label: Arrows on desktop
arrows_wide.info: A pointer can hover, so the arrows can wait for one.

arrows_compact.label: Arrows on mobile and tablet
arrows_compact.info: There is no hover here and a swipe already steps through the images, so the arrows can wait for that gesture instead.

hover_next.label: Show the next image on hover
hover_next.info: Previews the second image while the pointer is over the card.

show_video.label: Include the product video
show_video.info: Adds a product video to the card as a final view.

video_badge.label: Video label
video_badge.info: The chip that names the video while it is the view on screen — "360°", "On the model", whatever the footage is. Leave it empty to show no chip.

quick_view_compact.label: Show on tablet and mobile
quick_view_compact.info: The disc opens the piece in an overlay. With both off it is simply not shown — the card's own link still opens the product page.

cart_upsell.name: Cart upsell
cart_upsell.heading: Heading
cart_upsell.collection_info: Shown only while the cart is empty. Leave empty to use all products.

product_badges.name: Product badges
product_badges.custom_text_info: Type text or connect a product metafield. Leave empty for no custom badge.

image_fit.label: Image fit
image_fit.info: Fit shows the whole product against the card. Fill crops it to the frame.

zoom.label: Scale the photograph
zoom.info: A number — 1.15 enlarges by 15% — for photography shot with margin around the product. Connect it to a metafield with the dynamic-source button to give each product its own. Leave it empty for no correction.

product_title.wrap_info: How the title divides across lines. Minimum two lines inserts a balanced break when the title has at least three words. It never truncates, and long titles can use more lines.

focus.label: Image focus
focus.info: Use the collection image's focal point, or choose which area remains visible when the frame crops it.

article_excerpt.name: Article excerpt
article_excerpt.fallback_to_content: Use article content when the excerpt is empty
article_excerpt.fallback_info: Useful on article cards. Leave off on the article page to avoid repeating the full story.

full_container_width.label: Start a new row
full_container_width.info: Inside a horizontal Group, following children begin on the next line. The Line break preset enables this with no added height.

option_name.label: Option name
option_name.info: Which of the product's options to list — "Karat", "Size", "Length". Matched on the name, so it finds the right one whether it is first or third on a given product, and prints nothing on a product that has no such option. The words around the list are a Text block beside this one.

target_by.label: Target option by
target_by.info: Automatic is portable across mixed catalogs. Name follows the merchant's Shopify option name. Position follows Shopify's option order.
target_by.name: Name

option_name.label: Option name
option_name.info: Enter the option name exactly as it appears in Shopify, such as the shop's own name for color, size, material, or flavor. Nothing is hard-coded by the theme. Products without this option show no control.

option_position.label: Option position
option_position.info: Products without this option position show no control.

control.label: Shown as
control.info: Auto uses native Shopify swatches when this option has them and written values otherwise.

variant_action.label: Products with variants
variant_action.info: Choose what this card action does when a product has more than one variant. Direct-add choices use available variants only.

add_label.label: Add label override
add_label.info: Leave empty to use the translated Add to cart label and the cart name from Theme settings.

choose_options_label.label: Choose options label override
choose_options_label.info: Leave empty to use the translated Choose options label.

sold_out_label.label: Sold out label override
sold_out_label.info: Leave empty to use the translated Sold out label.

button.name: Button
button.color_info: Leave empty to use the current color scheme.

color.label: Line color
color.info: Leave empty to inherit the current color scheme's border color.

full_container_width.label: Take full container width
full_container_width.info: Gives the Border its own full row inside a horizontal Group.

video.label: Video
video.info: Shown instead of the image when selected.

image.info: Shown when no video is selected.

autoplay.label: Autoplay video
autoplay.info: Autoplay videos are muted. Turn this off to show video controls.

reveal_delay.label: Reveal delay
reveal_delay.info: Wait before the media enters after it reaches the viewport.

desktop_behavior.label: Desktop behavior
desktop_behavior.info: Expanded turns the accordion into open content on desktop while keeping it foldable on smaller screens.

group.name: Layout group

direction.label: Children layout
direction.info: Place this Group's direct children horizontally or vertically.

distribute.label: Horizontal alignment
distribute.info: Positions children left, center, right, or distributes the available horizontal space.

distribute_vertical.label: Vertical alignment
distribute_vertical.info: Positions children at the top, middle, bottom, or distributes the available vertical space.

align.info_horizontal: Positions children vertically. Text baseline is useful for a label beside a button.
align.info_vertical: Positions children left, center, right, or stretches them to the Group's full width.

wrap.label: Allow wrapping
wrap.info: Off keeps every child on one horizontal line however narrow it gets, so they squeeze instead of wrapping.

items_width.label: Side-by-side child widths
items_width.info: Choose whether side-by-side children fit their content or divide the available horizontal space evenly.

items_height.label: Stacked child heights
items_height.info: Choose whether stacked children keep their natural heights or share equal-height rows.

content_alignment.label: Content inside children
content_alignment.info: Aligns text and inline content inside each child box. A child block's own alignment still takes priority.

gap.label: Horizontal children spacing
gap.info: Sets the space between side-by-side children.

group.vertical_gap_info: Sets the vertical space between this Group's children. Use section default follows the section's inherited stack spacing.

padding.label: Inside spacing
padding.info: Adds equal space inside the Group. This is useful when borders are shown, but it does not require them.

group.show_borders_info: Turn on border controls for this Group. This does not change how its children are arranged.
group.border_color_info: Leave empty to use the current color scheme's border color.

stack_below.label: Responsive layout
stack_below.info: Fluid uses the available space and follows Allow wrapping. The stacking presets switch to a vertical layout based on the Group's own width rather than the screen's.

content_alignment_mobile.label: Content after stacking
content_alignment_mobile.info: When this horizontal layout becomes vertical, align its text and inline content independently.

accessible_label.label: Accessible label
accessible_label.info: Leave empty when the icon is decorative. Add a short label only when the icon communicates information that nearby text does not.

icon_size.label: Icon size
icon_size.info: Use the theme setting or choose another responsive preset for this icon.

hover_animation.label: Hover animation
hover_animation.info: Runs when the icon or the link, button, or Group containing it is hovered. Reduced-motion preferences turn it off.

color.label: Icon color override
color.info: Leave empty to use the current color scheme's accent color.

border_color.label: Frame border override
border_color.info: Leave empty to derive a subtle border from the current accent color.

background_color.label: Frame background override
background_color.info: Leave empty to derive a subtle background from the current accent and surface colors.

anchor.label: Anchor
anchor.info: Lets other links jump here, e.g. /#visit. Leave empty for none.

carousel_arrows.label: Arrow position
carousel_arrows.info: Beside the row, the arrows take room from the cards, so on a narrow screen they move back under it.

carousel_motion.label: Carousel animation
carousel_motion.info: How one page gives way to the next.

content_alignment.label: Content alignment
content_alignment.info: Blocks follow the section unless they set their own.

brand_display.label: Brand mark
brand_display.info: Automatic shows the Brand logo when one is uploaded and the wordmark otherwise. A logo choice with no logo uploaded falls back to the wordmark.

brand_logo_variant.label: Logo image
brand_logo_variant.info: Which uploaded brand image this surface uses. Automatic shows the main logo, preferring the dark-background logo on dark grounds. A choice with no matching upload keeps the automatic answer.

card_column_gap.label: Horizontal card gap
card_column_gap.info: Space between cards across a row. Rows above and below keep the theme's grid gap.

card_row_gap.label: Vertical card gap
card_row_gap.info: Space between wrapped rows of cards. This changes the gap only, not the card size.

full_height.label: Fill the screen height
full_height.info: The section occupies the full viewport, as in the design.

layout.label: Layout
layout.info: The grid reflows on the width it is given. The carousel shows one page of that same grid at a time.

heading_level.label: Heading level
heading_level.info: One Heading 1 per page. Sections below it should be Heading 2 so the page reads in order.

close_visibility.label: Close control
close_visibility.except_home: Show close except on the home page

header.name: Header

header_layout.label: Header style
header_layout.info: Both styles use the same native Shopify menu and the same account, search, and cart actions.

color_scheme.info: One scheme for the solid bar on every page. While transparent, the bar borrows the page's own ink instead.

nav_mode.paragraph: The design gives the home page a floating pill and the inner pages a full bar, so the two are set separately.
nav_mode.morph: Floating pill, expanding to a bar on scroll

nav_product_transparent.label: Transparent at the top of product pages
nav_product_transparent.info: The bar stands over the gallery in the page's own ink and turns into the ordinary solid bar on the way down. Without JavaScript it simply never turns solid.

brand_logo_variant_transparent.label: Logo while transparent
brand_logo_variant_transparent.info: Worn while the bar rests transparent over the gallery, handing over to the bar's own logo on the way down.

brand_logo_swap_fade.label: Fade between the two logos
brand_logo_swap_fade.info: Cross-fades with the bar's background as it turns solid. Off, the logo changes the moment the bar does.

scroll_threshold.label: Scroll distance before the bar changes
scroll_threshold.info: The cue for the pill's expansion and the product page's transparent bar turning solid. Where the page has a hero heading, that heading is the cue instead.

overlay_home.label: Let the home page hero sit under the bar
overlay_home.info: The bar starts transparent over the hero and turns solid on scroll. Other templates always reserve its height.

customer_account_menu.label: Customer account menu
customer_account_menu.info: Controls the links in Shopify's account sheet. The default menu is shared with customer account pages.

header.search_paragraph: Search behavior is selected globally in Theme settings → Search. Popular terms and featured pieces are used by the menu and drawer modes.

search_popular.label: Popular searches
search_popular.info: Separate with commas. Shown before anything is typed.

search_collection.label: Featured pieces
search_collection.info: Shown in the overlay before anything is typed.

menu_type.label: Opening the menu
menu_type.info: The drawer slides in from the start edge and folds its branches like the footer; the full-screen overlay drills into a branch with a Back row.

header.menu_paragraph: Menu rows are numbered automatically in the order they appear here. Cart and Search are added last when they are switched on above.

menu.label: Main menu
menu.info: Supports nested links up to three levels. Remove individual menu rows when this block should be the only navigation source.

header.menu_address_paragraph: The address under the menu comes from Theme settings → Shop details.

show_follow_on_shop.label: Show Follow on Shop
show_follow_on_shop.info: Lets customers follow the store in the Shop app. Shopify controls the branded button appearance.

menu.label: Menu
menu.info: Choose a Shopify navigation menu. Add action links such as #newsletter or #cookie-preferences as custom menu URLs when needed.

contact.name: Salon details
contact.paragraph: The address, telephone and email come from Theme settings → Shop details.

hero.name: Hero

image.label: Portrait image
image.info: A strong portrait or lifestyle image works best.

hero.carousel_paragraph: Add one tab per collection. The carousel shows two products at a time from the selected collection.

collection.label: Collection
collection.info: The products shown while this tab is selected.

media_fit.label: Product image fit
media_fit.info: How product images sit inside this tab's carousel frames.

limit_products.label: Limit how many products are shown
limit_products.info: Off shows the whole collection, up to the 50 Shopify returns in one page.

view_all_label.label: View all label
view_all_label.info: Leave blank to show the collection's product count.

view_all_link.label: View all link
view_all_link.info: Defaults to the collection above. Set this to send it somewhere else.

catalog.heading: Heading
catalog.sticky_search_header: Keep search header visible while scrolling
catalog.card_gap_info: Use theme default to match Product List sections. Choose another preset to override this page.

collection_header.name: Collection header

layout.label: Title and image layout
layout.info: Uses the Collection title/copy group and Collection image in this header.

image_width.label: Collection image width
image_width.info: Let the image follow the header width, expand beyond a narrow header to the normal page width, or ignore page width and reach the screen edges.

show_overlay.label: Show image overlay
show_overlay.info: Adds a color veil between the collection image and header text.

overlay_color.label: Overlay color
overlay_color.info: Leave empty to use this color scheme's background.

collection_header.height_info: Minimum height only. Content can always make the header taller.

intent.label: Recommendation type
intent.info: Related products are generated by Shopify. Complementary products are managed in Search and Discovery.

main_cart.name: Cart
main_cart.title: Heading override
main_cart.title_info: Leave empty to use the cart name from Theme settings.

quick_links_source.label: Collection filters
quick_links_source.info: Show collection names, use values from a Shopify filter configured in Search and Discovery, or hide the row.

collection_filter_button_style.label: Button type
collection_filter_button_style.info: Uses this button type's colors, shape, size, and hover animation from Theme settings.

other_control_style.label: Filter menu and sort style
other_control_style.info: Styles the Filter button and sort control. Collection filters use Button type.

quick_filter_name.label: Filter name
quick_filter_name.info: Enter the filter label exactly as it appears in Shopify. No catalog name is built into the theme.

enable_ajax.label: Update results without reloading
enable_ajax.info: Uses Shopify's section rendering response while preserving working links and forms when JavaScript is unavailable.

first_media_large.label: Make the first media larger
first_media_large.info: In Gallery grid, the first media spans the full gallery width on desktop.

video_first.label: Show video first
video_first.info: Moves hosted and external product videos before images while keeping variant media synchronized.

sticky_mode.label: Desktop sticky column
sticky_mode.info: Adaptive keeps the shorter column visible while the taller column scrolls.

autoplay_video.label: Autoplay hosted video
autoplay_video.info: Autoplay is muted and loops. Off, the gallery shows a play action instead — the theme draws no native video controls.

first_option.label: Show this option first
first_option.info: Enter a complete variant option name — Metal, Size, Karat. The matched option appears first and its choices keep the catalog's order. Leave empty for the catalog's order.

quick_links_source.label: Quick links
quick_links_source.info: Use values from a Shopify filter, show collection links, or hide the row.

quick_filter_name.label: Filter name
quick_filter_name.info: Enter the filter label exactly as it appears in Shopify. No catalog name is built into the theme.

enable_ajax.label: Update results without reloading
enable_ajax.info: Uses Shopify's section rendering response while preserving working links and forms when JavaScript is unavailable.

collections.label: Collections
collections.info: One card per collection, all from the single Collection card below.

block_gap.label: Section vertical spacing
block_gap.info: The default space down the page: between wrapped horizontal lines, between stacked children set to Use section default, and inside nested stacked Groups that inherit it.

content_alignment.label: Default child content alignment
content_alignment.info: Sets the starting alignment for text and inline content in this section. Individual blocks and nested Groups can override it.

custom_liquid.label: Custom Liquid
custom_liquid.info: Add custom Liquid or HTML. The section's color, width, and spacing settings control its surrounding layout.

video.label: Video
video.info: Plays muted and looped. Falls back to the image when empty.

delay.label: Delay before it appears
delay.info: Each splash is shown once per visitor. If another dialog is open, this one waits its turn.

accessibility_label.label: Accessibility label
accessibility_label.info: A short name read by assistive technology for a composable Splash screen.

offer_code.label: Discount code
offer_code.info: Must exactly match an active discount created in Shopify Admin. The apply button uses Shopify's native discount link.

offer_destination.label: Page after applying the discount
offer_destination.info: Defaults to All products. The discount remains applied for checkout.

ring_builder.name: Ring builder
ring_builder.enable_builder_info: Turn this off to pause the experience without deleting the page, redirect, or configuration.
ring_builder.heading: Heading
ring_builder.setting_collection_info: Use ordinary Shopify products and variants for metals, sizes, and setting styles. Only available variants can be selected.

cart_drawer.name: Cart drawer
cart_drawer.paragraph: Shown only while the cart is set to a drawer in Theme settings → Cart.

promise_label.label: Reassurance label
promise_label.info: Shown with the reassurance sentence when the tax note is on. Both are the design’s own copy.

note.label: Note when the tax note is off
note.info: Replaces the reassurance above when Theme settings → Pricing → tax note is off, because prices are then not tax-inclusive.
